chapters.title: Business Central growth and platform evolution

features.name: OptimAL Performance Initiative
features.description: A program to help partners build skills, tools, and engineering discipline to manage performance proactively rather than reactively, including agent capabilities.

features.name: Performance improvements through OptimAL
features.description: Partners report significant performance gains: 20% improvement, over 40% improvement, 2.5 times faster than 95th percentile, and 93% overall improvement.

features.name: Agent capabilities for performance management
features.description: Agent capabilities included as part of the OptimAL Performance Initiative toolkit for managing performance proactively.

quotes.text: We continuously evolve every layer of our cloud platform and tooling based on the real-world signals from our ecosystem
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes that platform improvements are driven by customer feedback and ecosystem signals, not internal assumptions.

quotes.text: Unhandled performance bottlenecks can ripple across this otherwise magnificent system and impact the overall experience
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains why partner code quality matters: performance issues in extensions affect the entire platform experience for end users.

quotes.text: High performance isn't a destination. It's a continuous journey.
quotes.why_it_matters: Sets the philosophical approach that performance optimization is ongoing, not a one-time effort.

quotes.text: Those that take performance seriously can now leverage the optimal performance initiative
quotes.why_it_matters: Marks the availability of OptimAL as a resource partners can access immediately.

quotes.text: We improved the performance by 20%. More than 40%. 2.5 times faster than 95%. A 93% improvement overall.
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides concrete, quantified results from partners using the initiative, demonstrating measurable impact.

quotes.text: Optimal raises the bar. Faster, more predictable systems that scale, happier customers, lower support costs
quotes.why_it_matters: Summarizes the business value proposition: performance improvements translate to customer satisfaction and cost reduction.
